turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did that hardware order for the Raspberry Pi 5 arrive yet? I'm itching to start the new project.
Checking the tracking number... yes, it was delivered this morning. You should have it in hand by now.

Nice. I just want to get a local LLM running on it for some offline tasks. I've been reading up on Qwen2.5. I think I'll stick with Qwen 2.5 (3b) is recommended for Raspberry Pi 5 due to its balance of speed and performance.
That sounds like a solid plan. The 3B parameter size is indeed a sweet spot for that hardware.
Yeah, anything larger feels like it'll crawl. By the way, did you see the rain forecast for tomorrow? It's supposed to be pouring.
Yes, heavy rain expected starting at 2 PM. I'd recommend moving your outdoor plans if you have any.
Good to know. I'll stay in and set up the Pi then. Can you remind me later what software I decided on?
Sure, I'll make a note. Is there anything else you need help with right now?
